Copied from dmrgo v2.0.5 transport/mmdvm/testdata. Its SOURCES.txt says:

pistar.txt was captured on 2026-10-20 with strace on the serial port of MMDVMHost on the
owner's Pi-Star (MMDVM_HS_Dual_Hat v1.6.0 firmware, protocol 1) during a restart of
MMDVMHost, and while it was idle. Each distinct frame is kept once. Each line is: direction
(h>m host to modem, m>h modem to host), frame in hex. Two values are placeholders, not
what the Pi-Star sent: the unique ID text after the version description is 24 "0"
characters, and the SetFreq frame has RX 430000000 Hz and TX 440000000 Hz.

mmdvmhost.txt holds the frames that MMDVMHost 9384d68 wrote on 2026-10-20 to a fake modem
over its UDP modem protocol on 127.0.0.1 (protocol 2), including one call that it sent on
slot 2 from the network. Each distinct frame is kept once, in the same line format. Its
SetFreq frame has the same placeholder frequencies.
